articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges the capabilities previously split across separate models. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, though researchers note diminishing returns on certain narrow evaluations compared to the GPT-4 to GPT-4o leap.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which sets new state-of-the-art results on SWE-Bench Verified and the recently introduced DevBench agentic software engineering suite. The model demonstrates the ability to autonomously navigate large codebases, write integration tests, and propose multi-file refactors with minimal human guidance, intensifying competition in the AI coding assistant space.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Three Additional Factories
articles.summary: Figure announced an expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots in three additional manufacturing facilities in the U.S. and Germany. The robots handle parts inspection, bin picking, and light assembly tasks, with BMW reporting a measurable reduction in repetitive strain injuries among line workers. The deployment represents one of the largest commercial humanoid robot rollouts to date.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Multi-Agent Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic shipped a major update to its Claude API enabling native multi-agent orchestration, where a supervisor Claude instance delegates subtasks to specialized agent instances with distinct tool permissions and memory scopes. Early enterprise adopters report dramatically simplified architectures for complex workflows like compliance review and supply-chain analysis, replacing brittle custom orchestration layers.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Disaster Site Inspection
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas humanoid performing fully autonomous structural inspection of a simulated earthquake-damaged building, navigating unstable rubble, climbing degraded staircases, and using onboard LiDAR and thermal imaging to flag hazards. FEMA is evaluating the system for pilot deployment, which could significantly reduce risk to human first responders in post-disaster scenarios.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Chips
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab. The node delivers approximately 20% better power efficiency over N2 and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs shipping in 2027, sustaining the cadence of transistor-level innovation despite longstanding predictions of Moore's Law stalling.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance to begin clinical trials of its N2 implant, which doubles electrode count to 2,048 channels and adds bidirectional stimulation capability. The approval follows promising 18-month data from the first-generation PRIME study participants, who demonstrated sustained cursor and robotic arm control, marking a significant milestone for therapeutic brain-computer interfaces.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Wave of Compliance Audits Targeting Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office launched its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta to assess adherence to transparency, systemic risk evaluation, and red-teaming requirements. The audits mark the transition from policy to enforcement and are expected to set precedents for how regulators worldwide approach oversight of general-purpose AI systems.
